page_title: TOT 2-2 MCI | Tottenham Hotspur v Manchester City 01/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' Nico (Manchester City) has tested the patience of referee Robert Jones and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+6' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+4' Pep Guardiola prepares a substitution. Rodri is replaced by Omar Marmoush (Manchester City).

90+2' Tottenham are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Junai Byfield (Tottenham) comes onto the pitch after Dominic Solanke signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
89' Manchester City have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
88' The manager makes a subsitution with Phil Foden (Manchester City) coming on for Bernardo Silva.
87' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
85' A lofted ball into the centre of the box is met with a forceful header by Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City), but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
83' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Manchester City.

82' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. Manchester City force their opponents to concede a corner.
80' Manchester City keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
78' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post.
77' The attendance is 61337.
76' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

75' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the roof of the net, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save. Good work from Tottenham as they win a corner.
74' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Gianluigi Donnarumma to make a comfortable save.
73' One of the players from Manchester City times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
72' The shots on goal statistics – 4:3.
70' 2 - 2 What a goal! Conor Gallagher swings a cross into the box and Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) scores a magnificent back-heel goal! 2:2.
70' Substitution. Rayan Ait Nouri makes way for Nico (Manchester City).
69' Today's match ends for Rayan Cherki who will be replaced by Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City).
68' Thomas Frank has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mathys Tel (Tottenham) replacing Randal Kolo Muani.
68' The game has come to an end for Yves Bissouma. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Wilson Odobert (Tottenham).
67' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but Gianluigi Donnarumma comes off his line to gather the ball.
65' Tottenham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
63' Marc Guehi (Manchester City) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just wide of the right post.
62' The referee awards a corner and Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) goes over to take it.

62' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The ball is out of play and Manchester City manage to earn a corner.
60' The game is interrupted. Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
58' Referee Robert Jones halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Pep Guardiola, then shows him a yellow.
57' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
55' Robert Jones sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
54' The Tottenham players halt their celebrations as referee Robert Jones makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

53' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) displays superb quick feet and dribbling as he jinks his way through multiple challenges and takes a shot from inside the box, which is deflected and goes past stranded Gianluigi Donnarumma. 1:2.
52' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) is about to take a corner kick.

51' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the top left corner. Unfortunately for him, Gianluigi Donnarumma makes a great save to stop his effort. The referee points to the corner flag and Tottenham will take a corner.
50' Conor Gallagher (Tottenham) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
48' Robert Jones shows a yellow card to Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) for his blatant foul.
46' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Thomas Frank probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Cristian Gabriel Romero. He is replaced by Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Robert Jones blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom right corner only for Gianluigi Donnarumma to dive and make a save.
45+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Rodri (Manchester City) was quite harsh and Robert Jones didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

45+2' Manchester City hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' 0 - 2 Goal! Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Bernardo Silva, then sends ball into the top left corner. 0:2.
43' High and wide! Rayan Ait Nouri (Manchester City) hits a first-time shot from distance that's none too pretty and goes miles wide of the left post.
41' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
40' The total number of attempts is 2:4.
38' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Jones had an easy-decision to make.
38' That's unlucky! Xavi Simons (Tottenham) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
37' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
35' Rodri (Manchester City) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
33' Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
31' Manchester City string together a series of short passes.
29' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham). Robert Jones saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
27' Ball possession – 39:61.
25' Looks like Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

24' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) unleashes a promising shot towards the top left corner after his wonderful solo run, but Guglielmo Vicario thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
23' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
21' Abdukodir Khusanov (Manchester City) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.

20' Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Robert Jones with no other option than to blow for a foul.
18' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) latches on to a precise cross on the edge of the box and strikes the ball goalwards. However, it goes just over the crossbar.
16' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
15' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
13' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City).
11' Yellow card. Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
11' 0 - 1 Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
9' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) commits a rough foul. Robert Jones stops the game and makes a call.
7' Tottenham players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
5' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
4' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.

2' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Guglielmo Vicario has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
1' The first half has just begun.
